name: Cavernous Hypnotic Modular
description: Dark, deep, and cavernous hypnotic techno inspired by Oscar Mulero and Lewis Fautzi. Features heavy industrial rumble, shifting modular textures, metallic percussions, and slow tectonic filter builds.

philosophy: Darkness as a canvas: The vibe is claustrophobic, deep, and cavernous. Space and reverb decays define the environment.
Tectonic evolution: Sounds morph slowly over 32 and 64 bars. Use complex automation envelopes on bandpass filters and feedback delay.
Metallic micro-rhythms: Anodized, industrial clangs and short metallic resonances create alien syncopation above the rolling sub.
Low-end pressure: Deep sub-heavy rumble tuned to D1 or Eb1 that moves physical air without masking kick punch.

sound_design.Tectonic Rolling Sub: Tune an 808/909 kick to D1. Send the tail through Live 12 Roar or Saturator with gentle drive. Low-pass filter at 110Hz with 24dB slope. Add a sidechain compressor keyed to the kick click so the sub swells between the four beats.
sound_design.Resonant Modular Drones: Take an analog sawtooth wave (Live 12 Drift or Wavetable). Run through a steep Bandpass filter with high resonance. Use Live 12 Shifter with slight frequency modulation to create dark eerie undertones.
sound_design.Metallic Percussion / Clangs: Synthesize a metallic ping using Operator (Frequency Modulation) or physical modeling (Live 12 Tension/Collision). Keep decay below 120ms. Route into an Echoboy or Live Delay set to dotted 16ths with ping-pong feedback.
sound_design.Cavernous Reverb Send: Set up a dedicated Return Track with Live 12 Hybrid Reverb (Convolution: Cavern / Abandoned Tunnel, Algorithmic: Shimmer/Dark). High-pass at 250Hz, low-pass at 6kHz. Send small amounts of hats, clangs, and modular bleeps to submerge them.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Establish the Cavernous Low-End Anchor
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Set BPM to 136. Create a tight, clinical kick transient and sculpt the rolling sub-bass swell. Verify phase alignment with utility mono bass enabled.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Craft the Modular Atmosphere Drone
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Create a slow-evolving 32-bar drone using Drift or Wavetable. Route cutoff to an LFO running at 1/32D. This serves as the dark bed throughout the entire track.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Layer Metallic Syncopation
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Program two distinct metallic percussion channels. Pan one slightly left (15L) and one right (18R). Apply random velocity and subtle micro-timing delays.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Execute the Tectonic Arrangement
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Follow the locators: maintain a deep 64-bar hypnotic foundation before introducing the main modular riff. Use the 32-bar cavernous breakdown to strip the sub, letting the spatial reverberations dominate before the drop.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Final Polish & Spatial Balance
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Check mono compatibility. Ensure cavernous reverb sends do not clutter the 200-400Hz muddy frequency region.

tracks.name: Kick
tracks.annotation: Punchy, dry, short decay. Tuned to D1. Serves as clock.

tracks.name: Tectonic Sub
tracks.annotation: Heavy rolling sub rumble. High-cut at 110Hz, sidechained to kick.

tracks.name: Cavern Hat
tracks.annotation: Dark, filtered 16th hats with slight swing and high-frequency roll-off.

tracks.name: Metallic Clang
tracks.annotation: FM synthesized metallic hits with dotted 16th ping-pong delay.

tracks.name: Modular Texture
tracks.annotation: Slow evolving modular resonant sequence with bandpass automation.

tracks.name: Industrial Drone
tracks.annotation: Cavernous low-mid ambient drone providing tension and depth.

tracks.name: Perc Polyrhythm
tracks.annotation: Syncopated percussion loop operating in odd meter for hypnotic pull.

tracks.name: Rumble FX
tracks.annotation: Sub drops, filtered noise impacts, and cavernous transition sweeps.

sections.name: Atmospheric Intro (64 bars)
sections.description: Deep sub rumble, kick, and industrial drone emerge. Essential DJ mix-in foundation.

sections.name: Groove Evolution (32 bars)
sections.description: Metallic clangs and polyrhythmic percussion layer in; drone modulation accelerates.

sections.name: Hypnotic Deep Peak (64 bars)
sections.description: Main modular sequence is unleashed. Full low-end power and relentless cavernous momentum.

sections.name: Cavern Breakdown (32 bars)
sections.description: Kick and sub drop out. Reverbs expand, modular filter opens wide, creating immense spatial tension.

sections.name: Second Descent Climax (64 bars)
sections.description: Kick and tectonic sub smash back in. Maximum saturation, full stereo depth and percussion.

sections.name: Deconstruction Outro (64 bars)
sections.description: Modular sequence filters away; strips down to kick, sub, and dark hat pulse for DJ out-mix.
